Ticking one or more limits this account to those groups' machines everywhere — lists, search, actions, scheduling, and the AI assistant. Machines in no group stay hidden from a restricted account, and "All machines" isn't available to it as a scheduling target. The audit log is never restricted.

strings.settings.general.commit_unknown: unknown (not a git checkout, and no GIT_COMMIT baked into this image)
strings.settings.general.ssh_identity_hint: debcontrol connects to machines using this one shared key when "SSH key" is chosen as the authentication method — there's no key upload/generation to do per machine. To let it manage a machine, append the public key below to that machine's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for the user debcontrol will connect as. Adding it to an already-managed machine can be done for you — see "Push pending key to all machines" below once you've generated a replacement key.
strings.settings.general.pending_key_generated_b: A replacement key was generated {generated_at} and is
strings.settings.general.pending_key_generated_a: . Append it to every managed machine's authorized_keys too (alongside the current one, don't remove the old line yet) before activating — activating switches which key debcontrol uses immediately, and any machine that hasn't got the new line yet will become unreachable.
strings.settings.general.push_result_partial: See the errors above for the rest.
strings.settings.general.push_key: Push pending key to all machines
strings.settings.general.push_key_hint: "Push pending key to all machines" runs a command over SSH (using each machine's currently active key) to append the pending key above to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys — for every machine using "SSH key" authentication with a pinned host key. It does not remove the old line or activate anything; it only saves you the manual copy-paste step above. Machines using password authentication aren't affected, since they don't use this key at all.
strings.settings.general.in_env_reachability: in .env) — TCP connect to the SSH port, no authentication
